title: canvas-v2
description: Structured 2D floor-plan input (the deterministic Path A source of truth). Plan coordinates are in canvas pixels; `scale.pixelsPerMetre` converts them to real-world metres. Vertical dimensions (wall/opening height, sill) have no pixel analogue and are given directly in metres. Doors and windows are PARAMETRIC: attached to a wall by id and positioned by a normalized offset along it, never by free x/y. This is the canonical target contract; the current editor still emits a bespoke flat `{elements:[]}` (see contracts/README.md) which the converter step migrates toward this shape.

version.description: Contract version tag. A breaking change bumps this; the schema is never mutated in place.

scale.description: Maps canvas pixels to real-world metres. The single source of truth for how large the drawing is.

pixelsPerMetre.description: How many canvas pixels represent one metre. e.g. 50 => a 300px wall is 6 m long.

wallHeight.description: Default extrusion height for all walls, in metres. Per-wall override may be added in a later contract version.

walls.description: Wall segments. Straight by default; a non-zero `curvature` makes the segment a quadratic Bezier bulge.

openings.description: Doors and windows, each attached to a wall and positioned parametrically along it.

labels.description: Free-floating text annotations. Non-structural; ignored by the geometry converter.

point.description: A point in canvas pixels (origin top-left, +y downward, matching the 2D editor).

thickness.description: Wall thickness in canvas pixels (converted to metres via scale.pixelsPerMetre).

curvature.description: Perpendicular bulge of the quadratic Bezier control point, in pixels. 0 (or absent) = straight segment.

opening.description: A door or window cut into a wall.

type.description: Discriminates a door (sill at floor) from a window (raised sill).

wallId.description: Id of the wall this opening is cut into. Must reference an existing wall.

offset.description: Parametric position of the opening's CENTRE along the wall: 0 = start, 1 = end.

width.description: Opening width measured along the wall, in canvas pixels (converted via scale).

height.description: Vertical height of the opening, in metres.

sillHeight.description: Height of the opening's bottom edge above the floor, in metres. Typically 0 for doors, >0 for windows.
